title: Should Schools Start Later?
text:
Many students feel tired in the morning. Some people think that schools should start later in the day. They believe students would sleep more and learn better. This idea is becoming popular in many countries.

However, some parents say that later start times would make afternoons too long. They worry about working parents who need their children to be at school early. Still, many experts agree that more sleep is important for teenagers. Therefore, the debate about school times will probably continue.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do some people think schools should start later?
options: Students would sleep more and learn better
Buses are always empty in the morning

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do some parents worry about?
What is the writer's most likely attitude towards later school start times?
options: The writer has no opinion at all
Schools should never change their timetable

questions.text: Why does the writer mention 'many experts agree'?
options: To support the idea that sleep matters for teenagers
To show that experts disagree with everyone
To explain how school buses work
To describe the history of schools

paragraph_translations: Muitos estudantes se sentem cansados de manhã. Algumas pessoas acham que as escolas deveriam começar mais tarde no dia. Elas acreditam que os alunos dormiriam mais e aprenderiam melhor. Essa ideia está se tornando popular em muitos países.

No entanto, alguns pais dizem que horários mais tarde tornariam as tardes longas demais. Eles se preocupam com pais que trabalham e precisam que seus filhos estejam na escola cedo. Ainda assim, muitos especialistas concordam que dormir mais é importante para os adolescentes. Portanto, o debate sobre os horários escolares provavelmente continuará.
